description:
FILED s532d (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) while running #3830's acceptance file.  PRE-EXISTING (base 06a4b8ba the same).

MEASURED (one-file `tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows HTTP-Message-7.01-0 t/message-decode-zipbomb.t`, 2026-11-08 ~02:5x, load ~2.5):
    default heap (1 GB), base AND tree: "Heap exhausted" before row 1 (pass=0; the round's "ran 5 of 9" did not reproduce here)
    PCL_DYNAMIC_SPACE_MB=1800, tree: pass=9 fail=0, 31.3 s, maxrss 1,298 MB
    PCL_DYNAMIC_SPACE_MB=1800, base: pass=9 fail=0, 28.9 s, maxrss 1,298 MB
    perl 5.40.3: 9/9, ~0.2 s, ~60 MB
So the file is held by MEMORY, not by #3830's quadratic snapshot (that mechanism is fixed by s532d and matters for the IO::Uncompress functional interface -- scratch/s532d/pr/zb.pl in the s532d worktree went from heap death at 39 s / 716 MB to 17 s / 435 MB): SBCL's (simple-array character) is 4 bytes per character, so each 16 MB byte string the test and HTTP::Message keep alive ($stream, the decoded content, the inflate buffers and their doubling, the copies the getters hand out) is 64 MB, and the 1 GB default holds about a dozen.

WHAT A FIX NEEDS (not designed): either (a) a per-FILE heap allowance for the CPAN board, as baselines/perl-suite-heap.tsv is for the companion (tools/run-dist-t.pl / tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl reading a registry and passing dynamic_space_mb to PCLSbcl -- the knob exists, PCL_DYNAMIC_SPACE_MB), which would make this row PASS with a cited allowance; or (b) byte strings stored as base-strings / octet vectors (a representation decision -- docs/DECIDED.md, grep `simple-base-string`: widening costs: textproc 3.5 s -> 6 min when a base-string met the regex engine; do not start it unasked).  (a) is a tools-layer change and the obvious first step.
Board row: HTTP-Message-7.01-0 message-decode-zipbomb.t *PLAN* re-keyed from #3830 to this task by s532d.
subject: HTTP-Message message-decode-zipbomb.t needs ~1.3 GB of heap under PCL (perl 60 MB): a 16 MB byte string is a 64 MB SBCL character string, and the 1 GB default heap holds too few of the test's copies -- passes 9/9 at PCL_DYNAMIC_SPACE_MB=1800 on the tree AND on the base
